clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 success with search results - API accepts invalid metricType without error

contract_refs: endpoint: entities+search requires valid metricType values (L2, IP, COSINE for float vectors)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: SearchReqV2 -> generateSearchParams -> NO metricType validation -> direct pass-through to gRPC. validateMetricType function exists but is NEVER called during search request processing
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:validateMetricType函数存在于internal/proxy/util.go,但仅在index创建时调用,搜索路径完全不验证metricType合法性。generateSearchParams函数直接透传metricType到后端,允许任意字符串值通过,这是真正的参数校验缺失

falsification.observed: Bug confirmed - invalid metricType values are silently accepted and search executes successfully

physical.objective_constraint: metricType must be a valid supported metric (enum constraint)

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 entities+search API accepts invalid metricType values without validation。源码接地发现 validateMetricType 函数存在但仅在索引创建时调用,搜索请求路径完全不校验 metricType 合法性。API 返回 HTTP 200 并正常执行搜索,表明参数校验缺失是真实漏洞。命中 developer_cognition 中 rest-v2-data-type-handling 盲点模式。
